title: Softphone in the desktop app for resell countries (G1)
goal: Let agents in the UK, US, Australia and Singapore make and take calls from the desktop app with their computer's microphone.
why: No softphone or WebRTC SDK exists in any client (audit 03 finding 1); the token endpoint issues an identity that the ring markup does not use (fixed by R301's identity rule); ADR-001 section 6 item 7.
blockedOnOwner: G1 (ADR-001 Addendum A: Twilio outside India, agency-owned Exotel in India)
newDependencies: the G1 provider's browser SDK (Plivo Browser SDK or @twilio/voice-sdk), exact version pinned
steps: lib/softphone: a Softphone interface (register(token), call(to, params), answer, reject, mute, hold, hangup, events) with the G1 provider SDK implementation and a mock implementation used when VOIP_PROVIDER is mock (e2e).
Electron: grant microphone permission for the app origin only (session.setPermissionRequestHandler allowing "media" for the loopback origin).
Token: backend GET /voip/token issues a short-lived provider token for clientIdentity(userId) (R301 rule) when the agency has calling and the user is an agent role.

UI: register on login when calling is enabled; screen pop Answer works; in-call panel with timer, mute, hold, note box, link to lead; mic check component on first setup (call-quality test, ADR risk table).
tests: desktop/e2e/softphone.spec.ts with the mock SDK and the simulator: inbound ring -> Answer -> panel timer -> hang up -> timeline entry; outbound from a lead -> panel opens with the lead.
Unit tests for the softphone state machine.
acceptance: Calls work end to end with the mock SDK; the real SDK is wired behind the same interface.
gate: cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/softphone.spec.ts e2e/calls-simulator.spec.ts
goLiveVerify: One real call per resell country with the G1 provider; audio quality on office networks; emergency-calling disclaimer in terms.
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Read docs/decisions/ADR-001-voip.md (sections 4, 6, 7) and docs/CALL-AUTOMATION.md (sections 2, 3, 4) before editing; they are the specification. G1 (provider choice and India shape) is not signed: everything here stays behind the VoipProvider interface.
Desktop UI follows desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md (ds-* tokens, archetypes, graceful degradation when VoIP is not configured). lint-gate must not rise for any touched file.
Blocked on G1 (provider decides the SDK).
ownerDecisionNote: Plivo dropped on 2026-10-14 (owner could not sign up). Target Twilio.
